name: Future Continuous
summaryPt: Ação que estará em andamento em um momento futuro.

meaningUses.pt: Ação em andamento em um momento futuro
meaningUses.en: I will be working at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
Don't call at 8. I'll be driving.

formation.pattern: I will be working — she will be working

examples.pt: Você estará estudando hoje à noite?

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + will. No, + pronome + won't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

examples.en: A: Will you be there? B: Yes, I will.
examples.pt: A: Você estará lá? B: Sim.

subjectAgreement.pt: A mesma forma (will be) para todas as pessoas.
subjectAgreement.example: I will be working. She will be working. They will be working.

pronunciation.pt: will be em fala rápida → 'll be.

contrast.pt: Future simple = decisão/previsão. Future continuous = ação em andamento num momento futuro.
contrast.en: I'll help you. (decisão) — I'll be working at 9. (em andamento)
contrast.enPt: Vou te ajudar. — Estarei trabalhando às 9.

examples.en: I will be working at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
Don't call at 8. I'll be driving.
She will be waiting for us.

examples.pt: Você estará estudando hoje à noite?

guidedPractice.full: She will be waiting for us.

guidedPractice.prompt: I ___ be sleeping at that time.
guidedPractice.full: I won't be sleeping at that time.

guidedPractice.pt: Você estará estudando hoje à noite?

guidedPractice.full: Don't call at 8. I'll be driving.

guidedPractice.prompt: This time tomorrow, I ___ flying to Paris.
guidedPractice.full: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Paris.
guidedPractice.pt: Amanhã a esta hora, estarei voando para Paris.
guidedPractice.explanation: Em andamento num momento futuro → will be + -ing.

guidedPractice.prompt: A: Will you be there? B: Yes, I ___.
guidedPractice.full: A: Will you be there? B: Yes, I will.
guidedPractice.pt: A: Você estará lá? B: Sim.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I will ___ sleeping at that time.
reviewQuiz.full: I will be sleeping at that time.
I won't be working on Sunday.
Will you be using the car?
Don't call at 10. I'll be sleeping.

reviewQuiz.prompt: This time next week, I ___ on the beach.
reviewQuiz.full: This time next week, I will be relaxing on the beach.
reviewQuiz.pt: Na próxima semana a esta hora, estarei relaxando na praia.

reviewQuiz.prompt: A: Will she be working? B: No, she ___.
reviewQuiz.full: A: Will she be working? B: No, she won't.
reviewQuiz.pt: A: Ela estará trabalhando? B: Não.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Resposta curta negativa: No, she won't.

reviewQuiz.full: He will be running at 6 a.m.

reviewQuiz.prompt: Don't call me then. I'll ___ a meeting.
reviewQuiz.full: Don't call me then. I'll be having a meeting.
reviewQuiz.pt: Não me ligue nessa hora. Estarei numa reunião.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Em andamento num momento futuro → will be + -ing.

reviewQuiz.prompt: Tomorrow at 8, we will be ___ (eat) dinner.
reviewQuiz.full: Tomorrow at 8, we will be eating dinner.
